items.prompt:
Use case: original game production weapon design reference, VEILBOUND HUNTERS request 6B. ONE sword only, no second matching sword, no character, hands, scabbard, stand, text, symbols, border, dimension line or cast/contact shadow. Plain uniform pale warm off-white background, no gradient or vignette. A precisely upright vertically aligned ORTHOGRAPHIC view, absolutely no perspective, tilt or foreshortening. Canvas MUST be portrait 3:4, at least1086 pixels wide by1448 pixels high. Prefer1086x1448 matching the supplied adopted reference canvas; the paired views must use the same canvas size. Entire object uncropped with small top and bottom margins. Render believable worn forged iron, simple riveted dull bronze fittings, wood under diagonal dark brown leather grip wrap, and a small bronze pommel. The same smithy and restrained grey-green/bronze/undyed/leather material family as the supplied adopted Dangaku and Gojin references. Practical inexpensive initial equipment, no ornate decoration or fantasy spikes. Use one definitive original design. Precision of the silhouette proportions and component alignment takes priority over decorative texture.
B-1: a single SATO-FORGED SOKEN short sword, the narrower lighter younger sibling of the adopted Gojin sword. Show the broad flat BLADE FACE exactly front-on. Single cutting edge on image LEFT, thick straight spine on image RIGHT. The highest sharp tip is at the left cutting edge; a simple diagonal drop slopes DOWN toward the right spine, like the adopted reference. Straight narrow blade body, not a curved dagger, not double-edged, not a large slab sword. Exact target proportions: overall length 70 cm; blade from highest tip to guard 54 cm; grip plus pommel 14 cm; remaining 2 cm assigned to small guard and plain collar together. Blade face maximum width 4.5 cm. Tiny simple riveted bronze crossguard total width 8 cm; use a low rectangular crossbar, not an ornate guard. Blade spine thickness is 0.8 cm (not visible as a broad side face in this front view). A wood-core one-hand grip with diagonal leather wrap and compact bronze pommel, no left/right-specific ornaments. Position the overall centerline at x=543 on a1086x1448 canvas. The sword extends from y=88 to y=1360 (1272pixels). Tip-to-guard distance is981pixels (tip y88; guard top approximately y1069). Guard+plain collar occupy y1069–1106 (37pixels combined). Grip+pommel occupy y1106–1360 (254pixels). Blade body width approximately82pixels; guard width approximately145pixels. If the output canvas is larger, scale ALL these pixel landmarks by the same factor. Keep narrow proportions; do not enlarge the blade to fill the broad blank canvas. The blade-face texture is subtle hammered grey iron, with a narrow worn cutting bevel along the left. Brass/bronze appearance must match the supplied Gojin hilt, without extra iron/bronze brackets along the blade.
